title: Two-Dimensional Networks of Lanthanide Cubane-Shaped Dumbbells

synthesis.procedure: A DMF (2 mL)/MeOH (3 mL) solution of NaN3 (0.016 g, 0.50 mmol) and Hcpt (0.024 g, 0.25 mmol) was slowly added to a MeOH (25 mL) solution of DyCl3·6H2O (0.25 mmol). The mixture was stirred for 15 min at room temperature, filtered, and the filtrate was left undisturbed for several days to give plate-like crystals.
synthesis.time: stirred 15 min, then several days undisturbed
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing and filtration; slow crystallization from filtrate
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate left undisturbed for several days to afford plate-like crystals suitable for SCXRD

properties.summary: dc χT of 55.7 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K decreases to 33.1 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K. Magnetization reaches 22.7 μB at 1.8 K and 7 T without saturation. Frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility below ~5 K and a small hysteresis loop at 0.04 K indicate SMM behavior of the cubane-shaped {Dy4} core with a small Ueff, attributed in part to QTM.

measurements.name: χT
measurements.conditions: 300 K, 1000 Oe, polycrystalline sample; compared to 56.7 cm3 K mol-1 expected for four free DyIII ions

measurements.name: out-of-phase ac susceptibility χ″
measurements.conditions: 1500 Hz, 1.8 K, 3 Oe ac field; frequency range 10–1500 Hz

measurements.name: hysteresis loop
measurements.value: small M/MS vs H loop with step-like feature and small coercivity
measurements.conditions: single crystal, 0.04–7 K, ±1.4 T along magnetic easy axis, micro-SQUID; sweep-rate dependent at 0.04 K
